limits: Full-vertex/oriented-face identity is a restricted VEIL recipe contract, not arbitrary geometry or reindexing equivalence.
BVH candidates exclude triangles sharing any vertex; noncoplanar adjacent foldover is not fully independently certified.
Near-coplanar overlaps use bidirectional float64 plane distances and projected SAT, not exact symbolic predicates or dynamic z-fighting validation.
Exactly one raw mesh, no modifiers/shape keys/parents/constraints/object or mesh animation or drivers; photographic scene.blend is out of scope.
No GPU, WebGL, dynamic flicker, physical iPhone, manufacturing, load or stability verification.

ligament_sampling.definition: Euclidean 3D separation of actual front/back mouth polylines to every other mouth and the same-side exterior rim; not developed geodesic, projected gap, minimal internal web thickness or manufacturing strength. Finite polyline samples give an upper estimate; subtract both segment covering radii and 0.2 um to obtain conservative polyline lower bounds.
ligament_sampling.excludes: Bore interior/rounded rim full surface minimum, unsampled smooth analytic continuation and arbitrary adjacent-face folding are not independently proven.
